name: Hashashin Shadow
summary: The legendary order of assassins who mastered fear as a weapon. Their mountain fortress hides secrets that kill.
lore: From Alamut's eagle nest, the Hashashin once terrorized kings and caliphs alike. Their shadow-magic lets them walk unseen and strike from darkness. They never forget a debt — and they collect with interest.

events.title: The Djinn Bottle
events.narrative: A merchant sells you a brass bottle that vibrates with trapped power. Something inside is very, very angry.

choiceA.label: Open the bottle and bind the djinn

random.winMessage: You bind the djinn to your will! Its power flows through your coven. +25% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The djinn breaks free and curses your followers. Six are lost. -6 Followers.

choiceB.label: Keep the bottle sealed and study it

events.title: The Star Reading
events.narrative: The Babylonian mages share a prophecy: a conjunction occurs tonight that has not happened in 4,000 years.

choiceB.label: Record the reading and sell it

events.title: The Cursed Caravan
events.narrative: A caravan arrives from the deep desert. Every member is dead, but their camels still walk and their cargo is intact.

choiceA.label: Claim the cargo and absorb the curse

choiceB.label: Burn the caravan and purify the route

events.title: The Hashashin Envoy
events.narrative: A masked figure arrives with a message from Alamut: 'Join us or be removed.' The dagger on the table is a hint.

random.winMessage: Your defiance rallies the faithful. +22% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The Hashashin strike in the night. Five followers vanish. -5 Followers.

events.title: The Sacred Geometry
events.narrative: A Qabbalah master offers to teach you the true name of a concept — any concept. The price is a year of your memory.

choiceA.label: Accept and learn the true name

events.title: The Sandstorm Spirits
events.narrative: A sandstorm reveals shapes moving within it — human, but not. They circle your compound and whisper in a language of wind.

events.title: The Cuneiform Tablet
events.narrative: A scholar brings a tablet inscribed in cuneiform that, when read aloud, causes the walls to bleed.

choiceA.label: Read the tablet and absorb its power

events.title: The Moon Calculation
events.narrative: The Babylonian star-readers predict an event that will occur in exactly 72 hours. The precision is terrifying.

events.title: The Underground City
events.narrative: Your scouts find a stairway descending into the dark beneath the ruins. The air coming up is warm and breathes.

choiceA.label: Descend and claim what lies below

choiceB.label: Seal the entrance and ward it

events.title: The Eclipse of Erebus
events.narrative: An unnatural eclipse darkens the sun at noon. The temperature drops thirty degrees. Something vast passes overhead.

choiceB.label: Shelter and wait for the light
